description.zh: 应用实例ID列表，最大长度为100。
description.en: The list of application instance IDs. Maximum length: 100.

description.zh:
是否查询已删除的实例信息。
该参数为true时AppInstanceIdList的字段必填，否则会报参数错误。
description.en: Specifies whether to query information about deleted instances. If this parameter is set to true, the AppInstanceIdList parameter is required. Otherwise, a parameter error is returned.

description.zh: 需展示的查询结果页码。默认值为`1`。建议填写该参数。
description.en: The page number of the query results to display. Default value: `1`. Specify this parameter.

description.zh: 每页的查询结果数量，不可超过`100`。默认值为`20`。建议填写该参数。
description.en: The number of query results per page. Maximum value: `100`. Default value: `20`. Specify this parameter.
The list of application instance statuses.
The list of user IDs. Maximum length: 100.

title.zh: 查询交付组内实例详细信息
title.en: Query instance details in a delivery group
